entry.summary:
I've thought that the new light-dark() CSS function can be used as a drop-in replacement for prefers-color-scheme media queries. Today I learned that they don't always behave the same. Here's how MDN describes the new color function: The light-dark() CSS <color> function enables setting two colors for a property [...] without needing to encase the theme colors within a prefers-color-scheme media feature query.
